purpose: Where a page sits in the app: a trail that collapses in the middle when it is long, renders through your router's link, and can emit schema.org JSON-LD.

supplied: a nav landmark with an accessible name
the current page is marked aria-current and is not a link
the collapsed middle is a real button that expands, not an inert ellipsis
separators are decorative and hidden from assistive technology
required: `renderLink` to use your router, so a breadcrumb does not full-page-reload the app
a trail that matches the page's actual position — a wrong one is worse than none

composition.notes: Items come from the `items` array. The last item is the current page and is rendered as text.

safeMutations.rationale: Collapsing and the separator are presentation. `items` is the page's position, `renderLink` is the router binding, and `structuredData` emits markup search engines consume.

propNotes.structuredData: Emits a schema.org BreadcrumbList as JSON-LD. It must describe real, reachable URLs.
